name: Ollama (local)
description: Open-weight models running on your own machine through Ollama. No API key; start Ollama and pull a model first, e.g. ollama pull llama3.2:3b

model.title: Model
model.description: Any model you've pulled. Small models answer fastest, which is what a voice call needs.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Where Ollama is listening. Use http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1 from inside Docker.

max_tokens.title: Max tokens
max_tokens.description: Upper bound on the length of each reply.
